load_transcript now enumerates lines and raises ValueError('{path}:{lineno}: {json error}') on a decode failure. ValueError is deliberate: json.JSONDecodeError already subclasses it, so nothing catching either type is affected, and metrics.py catches neither around parsing. _check_truncated_transcript covers the realistic case (a half-written object on the final line after a killed run) and asserts the reported line number is right even with a blank line earlier in the file, plus that a blank trailing line is still skipped rather than treated as corruption. agents.py, metrics.py and ocean.py self-checks all pass.
